title: Design, simulate, inspect
lead: Photonic engineering moves between geometry, process assumptions and several kinds of simulation.
description: AIFIELD’s described workflow aims to make those steps easier to examine together while keeping outputs tied to their conditions.

sections.title: The design inputs
paragraphs: Layer stacks and process descriptions frame the geometry that a solver evaluates. A useful result must preserve the assumptions about materials, boundaries and fabrication constraints.

sections.title: Several solver questions
paragraphs: Mode, circuit, field and thermal simulations answer different questions. Agreement in one calculation does not establish a manufactured device’s behavior.

sections.title: Glucose chip-design example
paragraphs: The sensing-design example demonstrates a design activity associated with ArtiSense. The output is a simulation/design artifact, not a measured glucose result.
